about.title: About Us
about.intro: Woodbine Preparatory School is a private primary school in Chhapra, Bihar. We help children take their first steps in learning with love, care and good habits.
about.mission: To give every child a strong start in education in a happy and safe place.
about.vision: To raise confident, kind and curious children who are ready for the future.
about.principalText: Dear parents, every child is special. At Woodbine we work together with you so that your child learns well, stays happy and grows into a good human being. We welcome you to our school family.
